target: TCD-025 A5 scope disposition and restricted parent routing

counter_hypotheses.alternative: A5 must remain an indefinitely open blocker because permanent exclusion would be equivalent to inventing science.
counter_hypotheses.test: Distinguish source-science closure from version-bound supported-scope governance.
counter_hypotheses.reason: The routing does not claim A5 is scientifically solved or admitted. It records that frozen revision53 does not support that surface and excludes it from the supported parent claim while allowing future model evolution to reopen it under a new explicit contract.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: A1-A4 completion automatically admits the original broad parent TCD-025.
counter_hypotheses.test: Apply B3I08 parent guards and MASSQ03 boundary result.
counter_hypotheses.reason: B3I08 forbids automatic parent admission and MASSQ03 rejects arbitrary partial saturated-reservoir cuts. A separate restricted parent composition decision remains mandatory.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: Narrow the parent silently to whole-profile only.
counter_hypotheses.test: Compare with the B3A10/B3I08 supported interval surface.
counter_hypotheses.reason: The qualified predicate supports more than whole-profile intervals. Whole-profile-only substitution would unnecessarily discard qualified selected-profile scope and would be a different claim.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: Because water is layer-resolved, permit partial saturated-reservoir cuts for the composed parent whenever the water ledger is closed.
counter_hypotheses.test: Apply the composed water/DOM/N/P claim semantics.
counter_hypotheses.reason: The composed parent requires all included public families to be scientifically meaningful on the same reported interval. Dissolved-species source closure fails for a partial mixed-reservoir cut, which is sufficient to exclude that interval from the composed parent.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: Treat A5 exclusion as a B3 scientific admission with a negative theorem.
counter_hypotheses.test: Inspect routed object and hard boundaries.
counter_hypotheses.reason: A5 remains not scientifically source-closed and is not B3-admitted. The disposition is governance of supported revision53 scope, not admission of missing observer physics.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: Use a residual-derived internal flux to preserve the original broad parent surface.
counter_hypotheses.reason: Residual completion makes the observer self-closing and is explicitly forbidden.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: RG05K must be rewritten immediately to include B3D31 before this routing can be qualified.
counter_hypotheses.test: Check aggregate cadence and whether B3I09 changes aggregate admission counts or opens a project gate.
counter_hypotheses.reason: B3D31 is one exact-final post-RG05K child admission, below normal batch cadence. B3I09 is routing-only and does not itself add an admission or open B4/production. The separate parent decision can consume exact pins without fabricating an early aggregate requirement.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: Permanent exclusion means future ANIMO versions may never support partial-reservoir reporting.
counter_hypotheses.test: Read the version bound on the disposition.
counter_hypotheses.reason: Permanence is explicitly frozen-revision53 scoped. A later model-evolution workunit may introduce and qualify a scientifically owned partial-reservoir observer/state contract.

counter_hypotheses.alternative: The parent identity can be renamed or split into a new top-level TCD because its supported scope is narrower than the original broad interpretation.
counter_hypotheses.test: Check canonical register and routing contract.
counter_hypotheses.reason: No new top-level TCD is required for a bounded supported-scope disposition of the existing TCD-025 claim. The canonical register remains unchanged and tail remains TCD-042.

residual_uncertainty: No qualified historical active-macropore B2 reference establishes historical magnitude or prevalence.
A future model evolution could define a different partial-reservoir state/observer contract, but that would be new separately qualified science.
Restricted parent composition has not yet been admitted.
Same-agent adversarial review is not independent.
